Select approved drugs (max_phase_for_ind = 4) with the indication 'schizophrenia'. Join drug_indication on mesh_heading, molecule_dictionary on molregno, and compound_structures on molregno. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, efo_id AS indication_curie, efo_term AS indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind.
